chunks: But the woman desired him, and he would have desired her but for the indication he received from his Lord. This was so that We may avert both evil and lechery from him, for he was one of Our chosen devotees.
ai.seo_question: How did Prophet Joseph resist temptation according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'proof' (burhan) that prevented Joseph is often interpreted as a divine light or vision of his father Jacob, symbolizing the spiritual clarity that guards the purified against sin. This event underscores the concept of 'Ismah' (infallibility) for prophets, demonstrating that their purity is not merely absence of sin but an active, divinely sustained state of being 'al-mukhlasin' (the purified). The verse thus serves as a theological foundation for understanding how divine grace actively intervenes to preserve the spiritual integrity of the chosen servants.
